Messages.Author: erewego
Messages.Body:
Member of the Entourage
Mortal with 2 life, 0 strength, 0 bleed. This ally cannot take actions. During a  action directed at you, this ally may burn 1 life to get +1 intercept. Burn this ally if he successfully blocks a vampire (no combat occurs).
[DRAFT]:  as above.

Basically, can you burn extra life to get more intercept? Even if it burns him?
Example:
Someone plays Entrancement and attempts to steal a Member of the Entourage at one stealth. Member of the Entourage burns a life to get 1 int to block. Entrancement gets another stealth. Can I burn another life to get another intercept, which burns Member of the Entourage causing the action to fail?

Also, if I have Vagabond Mystic, is there a window in above example to add another life?

Prince of New York,
Adam

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> erewego wrote:
> Member of the Entourage
> Mortal with 2 life, 0 strength, 0 bleed. This ally cannot take actions. During a  action directed at you, this ally may burn 1 life to get +1 intercept. Burn this ally if he successfully blocks a vampire (no combat occurs).
> [DRAFT]:  as above.
>
> Basically, can you burn extra life to get more intercept? Even if it burns him?
> Example:
> Someone plays Entrancement and attempts to steal a Member of the Entourage at one stealth. Member of the Entourage burns a life to get 1 int to block. Entrancement gets another stealth. Can I burn another life to get another intercept, which burns Member of the Entourage causing the action to fail?
>
Member of Entourage can burn 1 life to get +1 intercept once per action ("During X do Y" template).
With a Member of Entourage having 1 life at the beginning of the action, if it burns 1 life to get +1 intercept in this action, it burns (provided it doesn't gain life in between). If the action was sup' Far Mastery, it fizzles (no cost is paid).

> erewego wrote:
> Also, if I have Vagabond Mystic, is there a window in above example to add another life?
>
> Prince of New York,
> Adam
>
If the acting minion plays inf' Crocodile's Tongue, there is a window after burning the life to cancel CT, and before burning a blood for +1 intercept.

Messages.Author: erewego
Messages.Body:
Thanks... but why can I only do it once? Wording seems similar to Maris Streck
Camarilla Justicar: Maris can burn a blood to give a blocking minion +1 intercept. She can take a +1 stealth action to allow you to look at and rearrange the top 5 cards of your library.

So if the Member of the Entourage has 3 life (or 4 or 5...) I can't burn more then one life as the stealth is increased?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Because Maris lacks the "During X do Y" template.
In VTES, this template limits to once per X the use of Y.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> erewego wrote:
> Thanks... but why can I only do it once? Wording seems similar to Maris Streck
> Camarilla Justicar: Maris can burn a blood to give a blocking minion +1 intercept. She can take a +1 stealth action to allow you to look at and rearrange the top 5 cards of your library.
>
Wording is slightly different.
Maris' cardtext doesn't involve "During". Therefore, you can use any number of times to get intercept in an action.
"During X do Y" is a template used in several cards that limits the possibilities of doing X to once per X.
Usual examples: Temptation (it only adds 1 counter per Master Phase), Blood Doll (it doesn't work like Minion Tap), sup' Drawing out the Beast doesn't inflict several damage during the press step, ..

> erewego wrote:
> So if the Member of the Entourage has 3 life (or 4 or 5...) I can't burn more then one life as the stealth is increased?
>
Can't burn more than 1 life to get intercept per its cardtext, correct.
